description: Labels for recorded landmark sessions (docs/testing/test-plan.md). Times are seconds from the first observation in each file. Expected counts are ranges: 'user' = what the person who recorded reported, 'data' = what is visible in the landmarks.

segments.notes: user: about 10. Hand stays in view between holds (continuous Open_Palm); fingertips rise and fall 8-10 times. Wrist near the bottom edge of the frame.
user: about 10; data: 9 fast moves to the user's left. Return strokes present.

user: about 10; data: about 6 moves reach 25% of the frame within 500 ms. Fast wind-up moves to the left precede several swipes. Classifier often reports None (palm sideways). Week 3 analysis: most right swipes were not tracked (hand low at y≈0.85-0.9 and partly out of frame; MediaPipe mostly saw a small resting hand at the center), so only 2-3 swipes have tracking data. The strict checks are no wrong-direction swipes and no palm holds.
user: normal activity, no gestures. Contains 8 natural closed fists, each preceded by a brief open hand.

Corrected in Week 3: the earlier label (3 holds of 1.6-2.8 s) counted continuous palm runs. The palm is pushed toward the camera in plateaus of 0.5-0.8 s, and the classifier reports None while the palm is close, so the hold count is ambiguous.
data: 6 swipes, each followed by a return stroke.
data: 6-8 swipes, less regular, with wind-ups and returns.
